v0.0.1-pre-alpha.description:
Pre Alpha build of Unleashed Archipelago
Sorry for the lack of a windows build
I'd rather keep this contained until alpha. You may show it off but please don't share it around

NOTES ::
- Only locations right now are non-dlc stage completions and the 4 shoe upgrades
- Chaos Emeralds are completely unimplemented
- Hub Rando and Act Shuffle are completely unimplemented
- You will need to go through Eggmanland and Egg Dragoon. I am unsure if you need to beat Dark Gaia twice
- Story progression may be logically scuffed
- Saves are ***NOT*** automatically redirected yet!
- Place `connection.ini` in your user folder (one level up from your saves) and edit connection information accordingly

To build the client yourself, run `process_apshared.py` then follow the recomp's build instructions
v0.0.1-pre-alpha.title: v0.0.1-pre-alpha

v0.0.2-pre-alpha.description:
# Changelog
- Implemented Chaos Emeralds
- Implemented Hub Rando (now the only progression mode)
  - NOTE: The hubs are still visible on the world map
- Implemented act level randomization
- Added a toggle for including day/night locations
- Added an option to put acts into the item pool
- Added item and location groups
- Begun work on MedalSanity

# Notes
- I'd rather keep this contained until alpha. You may show it off but please don't share it around
- The internal version number was not incremented
- Saves are ***NOT*** automatically redirected yet!
- Place `connection.ini` in your user folder (one level up from your saves) and edit connection information accordingly
- To build the client yourself, run `process_apshared.py` then follow the recomp's build instructions
v0.0.2-pre-alpha.title: v0.0.2-pre-alpha

v0.0.3-prealpha.description:
# Changelog
- Added experience and ring filler items
- Added logic to medals
- Added mediasanity
- Added souvenir and mission medals
- Emeralds now visually affect the world map
- Added "Sent Item" achievement prompt
- Added images when receiving certain items

# Notes
- You ***MAY*** share this around, but please keep it outside the AP ring of servers
- The mission medals ***ARE MISSABLE*** in this release
- Shop Logic is not great, requiring only 2 level completions and the hub for shops to be in logic
- Saves are ***NOT*** automatically redirected yet!
- Place `connection.ini` in your user folder (one level up from your saves) and edit connection information accordingly
- Place the `SWAAP` folder in the same folder as the executable
- To build the client yourself, run `process_apshared.py` then follow the recomp's build instructions
v0.0.3-prealpha.title: v0.0.3-prealpha

v0.1.0-alpha.description:
# The public release of Sonic Unleashed AP
- Level completions are locations by default
- Option for medal and media locations (with options to disable shop and mission locations)
- Option to disable day/night locations
- Reverse, Slow, and Fast Traps
- Find each hub (and optionally act) to progress
- Find the Eggmanland Hub, Level 7 Sun, Level 6 Moon, and the 7 Chaos Emeralds (and the Dark Gaia act if enabled)  to defeat Dark Gaia and goal
- Optionally randomize medal requirements for acts
v0.1.0-alpha.title: v0.1.0-alpha
